Current clinical trials and translational research studies at VMCVM
General Item
Evaluation of a treatment for Equine Osteoarthritis
The purpose of this study is to assess the effect of BIO-PLY on lameness reduction in horses affected with osteoarthritis.
tag:
Horses
tag:
Recruiting
General Item
Developing a non-invasive treatment for canine thyroid tumors
The purpose of the study is to evaluate histotripsy, a new, non-invasive way of treating canine thyroid tumors that can precisely target and destroy abnormal tissues without incisions or radiation.
tag:
Oncology
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
General Item
Evaluating a Clotting Enzyme in Dogs with Protein Losing Nephropathy
The purpose of the study is to evaluate a clotting enzyme, ADAMTS13, in dogs with protein losing nephropathy (PLN). Protein losing nephropathy is a form of kidney disease that causes protein loss in the urine. Dogs with PLN have a higher risk of blood clotting disorders, but the mechanism isn’t well understood.
tag:
Internal Medicine
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
General Item
Comparing measurements in dogs with Pulmonary Hypertension
The purpose of this study is to compare the accuracy of measurements in the lungs obtained from a non-invasive heart ultrasound (echocardiogram) to the measurements obtained from right heart catheterization to better diagnose, classify, and treat pulmonary hypertension in dogs.
tag:
Cardiology
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
General Item
New Therapy for Canine Brain Tumors
Purpose: To determine if it is safe and feasible to use a light-sensitive drug called verteporfin, in combination with photodynamic therapy (PDT), in dogs with newly diagnosed brain tumors.
tag:
Neurology
tag:
Oncology
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
General Item
Evaluating Effects of a new Bone Tumor Treatment
Purpose: To evaluate the effects of histotripsy, a novel treatment for that can destroy tissue without radiation or heat, on dogs with osteosarcoma.
tag:
Oncology
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
General Item
Amputation and Chemotherapy for Osteosarcoma
We are seeking dogs whose owners have decided on the standard of care treatment option for canine osteosarcoma.  This includes amputation and chemotherapy.  This study aims to check for the spread (metastasis) of the cancer and will follow patients until the time which the dog develops metastasis.  We will use this information to compare against our other clinical trials.
tag:
Oncology
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
General Item
A Nerve Conduction study on Dogs with Intervertebral Disc Extrusion
Purpse:  To determine if a nerve test, performed on paralyzed dogs before surgery for a slipped disc, can predict whether they will regain the ability to walk.
tag:
Neurology
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
General Item
Canine Lipomas
Purpose: To evaluate the safety and effectiveness of treating lipomas in dogs with a single treatment.
tag:
Community Practice
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
General Item
The Role of Habitual Physical Activity on Pregnancy Health and Whelping in Dogs
Purpose: To identify how routine physical activity affected the health of the pregnancy and ease of whelping in dogs.
tag:
Recruiting
tag:
Dogs
tag:
Theriogenology
General Item
Analyzing the hearts of Cavalier King Charles spaniel puppies
Purpose: To monitor the mitral valve structure of Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (CKCS) puppies and to compare the structure of CKCS puppies’ mitral valves to puppies of other breeds.
tag:
Cardiology
tag:
Dogs
General Item
Targeted chemotherapy for brain tumors in dogs
Purpose: To determine the safety and effectiveness of a new chemotherapy drug and drug delivery method in the treatment of brain tumors (gliomas) in dogs.
tag:
Neurology
tag:
Oncology
tag:
Dogs
General Item
A new screening tool for dilated cardiomyopathy in Doberman Pinschers
Purpose: To test whether speckle tracking echocardiography will be able to detect changes in the hearts of Dobermans who have abnormal 24-hour Holter monitoring but normal standard echocardiograms.
tag:
Cardiology
tag:
Dogs
General Item
How Nutrition, Weight and Exercise affect Fertility and Reproduction in Female Dogs
Purpose: To identify how body condition, exercise, and nutrition affect the reproductive potential of female dogs and the health of their puppies.
tag:
Dogs
tag:
Theriogenology
General Item
Assessing Blood Pressure Monitoring in Dogs Undergoing Anesthesia
Purpose: To test whether using advanced cardiac monitoring techniques provides a more accurate measurement of cardiac output and helps clinicians better determine when anesthetized dogs need more cardiovascular support to maintain a healthy cardiac output.
tag:
Anesthesiology
tag:
Dogs
General Item
A Survey on Whelping in the Female Dog
Purpose: To create a large database on the timing of whelping milestones in dogs.
tag:
Dogs
tag:
Theriogenology
General Item
Identifying Molecules to Aid in Developing a Vaccine Against EPM (Equine Protozoal Myeloencephalitis)
Purpose: To identify immune molecules that may be protective against S. neurona infection as a first step towards developing a vaccine against EPM.
tag:
Neurology
tag:
Horses
General Item
Evaluating the Hearts of Young Cavalier King Charles Spaniels
Purpose: To evaluate if young CKCSs with mild mitral regurgitation develop heart enlargement earlier than young CKCSs with no mitral regurgitation.
tag:
Cardiology
tag:
Dogs
General Item
3-D Evaluation of the Feline Heart
Purpose: To assess the feasibility of performing 3D echocardiography in healthy cats and to establish the standard range of dimensions for measuring the heart chambers in healthy cats

**This study is concluded
tag:
Cardiology
tag:
Cats
tag:
Finished Recruiting
General Item
A Non-Invasive Approach to treating Equine Sarcoids
Purpose: To evaluate the effectiveness of histotripsy as a non-invasive therapeutic approach for treating equine sarcoids.
tag:
Surgery
tag:
Horses
General Item
New Testing to Predict Survival Times in Sick Cats
This study will test feline Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (fTSH) using a new method on ill and healthy cats to determine if this test can predict outcomes and guide clinical decisions.
tag:
Cats
tag:
Internal Medicine
General Item
A Survey on Parasite Control Practices
The aim of this study is to evaluate the parasite control practices implemented by dog owners for their pets. Additionally, we will assess dog owners' awareness and knowledge regarding parasite prevention and management.
tag:
Parasitology
tag:
Dogs
